item.title: Where to Eat in Carrollton’s Koreatown: The Best Korean Restaurants in DFW
item.description: When Meryvn’s shopping center in Carrollton closed in 2006, the fate of this once-decaying strip would be changed forever by a group of Korean investors. Edward Choi and others purchased the old center in 2007, and despite various obstacles, brought in a Super H-Mart, believing that it would boost Carrollton’s economy.
